rows.name: start: the genesis list is exactly [op1] and isReady
setStandby called directly (not by FoundationDAO) is refused
rows.detail: The contract function "setStandby" reverted with the following reason: StandbyValidators: only FoundationDAO

rows.name: DAO Execute (3 of 5) replaces the list with the 5 operator keys, INCLUDING op2 (seat sold) and op3/op4 (seats migrated): accepted, version 1, StandbyUpdated, isReady
OBSERVATION: after a seat SALE (op2 -> buyer3) and two MIGRATIONS (op3 -> heir1, op4 -> heir2) staleMembers() is empty: the operator key stays with the seat, so those members are not stale
the list rules, simulated from the FoundationDAO address: unsorted, duplicate, a non-operator address and an empty list are all refused with the contract reason
rows.detail: unsorted: refused; duplicate: refused; not an operator key (heir3 is a plain wallet): refused; empty: refused

rows.name: owner5 requests exit (Exiting, seat burned): op5 is reported STALE by staleMembers() and isReady() turns false

a DAO proposal that still lists the exited op5 is REFUSED at execution (the third vote reverts: not the current operator key of a registered seat); the proposal stays Pending and the list is unchanged
rows.detail: Execution reverted with reason: Execution reverted (StandbyValidators: not the current operator key of a registered seat).

rows.name: a DAO proposal with the refreshed list (4 members, without op5) executes: version 2, no stale member, isReady true
the net keeps running (QBFT set now 4 after the exit of owner5)
